title: 1P2KeePass
description: This plugin can import 1Password 1PIF files.
note: KeePass 2.x has a built-in import module for 1Password 1PUX files.

title: OnePIF
description: This plugin can import 1Password 1PIF files.
note: KeePass 2.x has a built-in import module for 1Password 1PUX files.

title: OneVault
description: This plugin can import 1Password OPVault files.
note: KeePass 2.x has a built-in import module for 1Password 1PUX files.

title: DataBaseReorder
description: This plugin adds a command to reorder all groups alphabetically.
note: KeePass 2.15 and higher has group reordering commands built-in.

title: DataBaseBackup
description: Creates backups of modified databases.
note:
DataBaseBackup does not use KeePass' I/O infrastructure,
therefore the plugin is incompatible with most other plugins that
are providing support for more protocols (like IOProtocolExt).

title: KPSimpleBackup
description: This plugin saves a backup of your database to a backup location and keeps a specific amount of the newest backups (that you can define) every time you save your database or trigger the backup manually.

title: SimpleDatabaseBackup
description: This plugin creates a backup every time a database is saved. The backups are placed in the database folders.

title: CardFileKPPlugin
description: This plugin can import CRD files that were created by Cardfile.

title: CodeWallet 3 Import
description:
This plugin can import TXT files that were exported by CodeWallet 3.
Note that this importer is specifically for CodeWallet 3 files. KeePass 2.x already includes an importer for CodeWallet 6 files.

title: CodeWallet 6 Konverter
shortdesc: Converts TXT files exported by 'CodeWallet 6' to importable CSV files.
description: This tool converts a CodeWallet 6 TXT file to a CSV file that can be imported into KeePass using the Generic CSV Importer.
note:
KeePass 2.x has a built-in importer for CodeWallet 6 files.
However, the Konverter additionally supports groups and field associations.

title: eWallet Data Liberator
shortdesc: Export data from 'eWallet' and import it into KeePass.
description: Export data from eWallet to an XML file, which can then be imported into KeePass. Please read the Readme.txt file included in the download for instructions how to install the exporter and the KeePass plugin that can import the exported XML file.

title: eWallet2KeePass
description: Convert an export file created by eWallet to a KeePass XML (2.x) file.

title: KeeAnywhere
shortdesc: Adds support for online storage providers.
description: KeeAnywhere is a KeePass plugin that provides access to cloud storage providers (cloud drives) like Amazon AWS S3, Box, Dropbox, Google Drive, HiDrive, hubiC or OneDrive. The main goal is to offer a simple UI while integrating deeply into KeePass. This covers all kind of users: novices, experienced and power users.
note:
KeePass 2.x already has built-in support for local files and files accessible
via standard protocols (FTP, HTTP, HTTPS, WebDAV, ...), see the help pages
'Loading/Saving From/To URL' and
'Synchronization' for details.
The KeeAnywhere plugin is only required when using online storage providers
that are not accessible via standard protocols.

title: ProtonDriveSync
description: This plugin adds support for directly accessing database files stored on ProtonDrive.

title: KeePassSync
description: KeePassSync is a KeePass plugin that synchronizes your database using FTP/SFTP or various S3-compatible online storage providers (including Amazon S3, Backblaze B2, Cloudflare R2, Google Cloud Services, Alibaba Cloud, Digital Ocean, Synology, Rclone, and more). This allows two or more computers to easily keep their data in sync.
note:
KeePass 2.x already has built-in support for local files and files accessible
via standard protocols (FTP, HTTP, HTTPS, WebDAV, ...), see the help pages
'Loading/Saving From/To URL' and
'Synchronization' for details.
The KeePassSync plugin is only required when using online storage providers
that are not accessible via standard protocols.

title: KPGoogleSync
description:
Synchronize KeePass database with Google Drive using Google API.
Features include: manual sync from 'Tools' menu, enable/disable sync on save, only sync if local database is newer than remote database in Google Drive.

title: KPGoogleSync (fork)
description:
Synchronize KeePass database with Google Drive using Google API.
Features include: manual sync from 'Tools' menu, enable/disable sync on save, only sync if local database is newer than remote database in Google Drive.

title: KeePassOneDriveSync
description: This plugin allows synchronizing multiple local databases with multiple databases stored in OneDrive.

title: KeePassMasterSlaveSync
description: This plugin allows synchronizing specific entries only. The entries to be synchronized can be defined by parent group names and/or by tags.

title: DoubleClueKeePassPlugin
description: This plugin stores and retrieves KeePass database files in/from DoubleClue CloudSafe, a cloud protecting data with multi-factor authentication (MFA).

title: KPScript
description: This utility allows scripting KeePass. For details, see the KeePass Scripting Documentation.

title: On-Screen Keyboard 2
shortdesc: Extends KeePass by an on-screen keyboard.
description:
When opening a database, this plugin automatically shows an on-screen keyboard for entering the master password.
This plugin runs on Windows 2000 and higher. Unix-like systems are not supported.

title: PasscommImport
description: This plugin adds support for importing Password Commander CSV files.

title: Password Minder Import
description: This plugin imports Password Minder data.

title: SafeInCloudImp
description: This plugin adds an import module for XML files created by SafeInCloud.

title: SpmImport
description: This plugin adds an import module for files created by Steganos Password Manager 16.
note:
The SpmImport plugin is discontinued.
KeePass has a built-in import module for Steganos Password Manager CSV files
(exported by version 20.0.7 or higher), i.e. no plugin is required.

title: KeeResize
description: The KeeResize plugin makes several KeePass 2.x dialogs resizable.

title: KeeTheme
description: Changes the appearance of KeePass and allows you to create your own custom themes.
note:
KeePass supports all system themes (including
dark ones) without a plugin.
The KeeTheme plugin is intended for changing KeePass' appearance
independent of the active system theme.

title: KeeUIExt
description:
This plugin provides various user interface options:
General:
When pressing Ctrl+Backspace, delete the word to the left of the cursor. Scroll menus with mouse wheel.
Main Window:
Forget last used database if it does not exist anymore. Show confirmation dialog when closing a database.
Main Group Tree:
Collapse all groups when opening a database. Show 'Duplicate Group' command in the group context menu.
Main Entry List:
Focus entry list when opening a database. Draw grid lines. Show 'Duplicate Entry' command in the entry context menu. Show 'Print Entry' command in the entry context menu.
Advanced:
Custom user interface font. Note: if you want to change the font size, see the FAQ item 'How to change the GUI font (size)?'. Changing the font size using the KeeUIExt plugin may result in layout issues.

title: Vault3Importer
description: This plugin adds support for importing Vault3 XML files.

title: VaultSync
description: This plugin adds support for importing HashiCorp Vault data.

title: KeeForm - Form Filler Utilities
shortdesc: Opens websites and fills in the login data automatically.
description:
KeeForm is designed to open and scan a web site for input fields and fill them accordingly with a user name and password. Please note, this is done without any "auto-typing", therefore it is very safe to use: you don't need to be worried that your data could be accidentally typed into a different window. KeeForm comes with an easy-to-use installer.
KeeForm works with Mozilla Firefox, Google Chrome and Microsoft Edge.

title: Kee
shortdesc: Bridge between KeePass and web browsers.
description:
Kee adds free, secure and easy to use password management features to your web browser which save you time and keep your private data more secure.
Kee connects your web browser to KeePass. It requires KeePassRPC.

title: ChromeIPass
shortdesc: Integrates KeePass and the Google Chrome browser.
description: This extension connects your web browser (Google Chrome) to your KeePass database (via the KeePassHttp plugin), enabling seamless, secure autofill of user names and passwords on websites you visit.

title: Passafari
shortdesc: Integrates KeePass and the Safari browser.
description: Extension allowing Safari to form-fill passwords stored in KeePass.

title: KeePasser
shortdesc:
Allows auto-typing into webforms based on URLs
(Internet Explorer and Maxthon).
description: This extension allows to execute auto-type based on the current web browser URL instead of the window title.

title: KPUInput
description:
This plugin allows auto-type on Linux systems with a Wayland compositor.
See 'Auto-Type on Wayland'.

title: WebAutoType
shortdesc:
Allows auto-typing into webforms based on URLs
(multiple browsers).
description:
This plugin allows to execute auto-type based on the current web browser URL instead of the window title.
Various browsers are supported (Internet Explorer, Firefox, Opera, Chrome, ...).

title: KPFloatingPanel
shortdesc: Displays an always on top KeePass floating panel.
description: This KeePass plugin shows an always on top KeePass floating panel. It allows you to use your passwords (auto-type, copy to clipboard) without opening the KeePass window.

title: KeePassHelper
shortdesc: Browser extension that stores/retrieves credentials/passkeys in/from KeePass.
description: This browser extension stores/retrieves credentials in/from KeePass, and it adds support for passkeys stored in KeePass. KeePassHttp is required.

title: KeePassFirefoxImporter
description:
Allows passwords from Firefox to be imported into KeePass.
For KeePass 1.x, a stand-alone converter is available. For KeePass 2.x, there is a plugin that integrates the import functionality directly into KeePass.

title: KeePassBrowserImporter
description: This plugin imports credentials from various browsers.

title: KeePassPfpConverter
description: Adds support for importing and exporting Pain-free Passwords JSON files.

title: KeeToReady
description: This plugin imports and exports ReadySignOn records.

title: MSDN/TechNet Key Importer
description: Adds support for importing MSDN/TechNet key files.

title: KeePass2KeyRing
description: Keyring is a password manager for Palm OS. For both KeePass 1.x and 2.x, there are applications/extensions to export KeePass data to Keyring files (which can then be used on Palm OS using Keyring). KeePassToKeyring

title: KeePassNewKeyExport
shortdesc: Export data with a new master key.
description: Export data with a new master key.
note:
KeePass 2.47 and higher has a built-in option 'Use a different master key'
on the 'Options' tab page of the export dialog.

title: PartialKeePassDatabaseExport
description: Export tagged entries to a new database. The new database can use a different master password.

title: KeePassSubsetExport
description:
Export tagged entries to a new database. The new database can use a different master password.
The group structure is copied to the new database, multiple export jobs are supported, and protection of the new database using a key file is supported.

title: Password Counter
shortdesc: Counts and shows entries sharing a password.
description: This plugin provides a button in the entry dialog with the number of entries that use the password of the open entry, too. It is possible to get the complete list of entries that use the reference password (by clicking the button and choosing the menu item for this).

title: Readable Passphrase Generator
description: The Readable Passphrase Generator plugin generates passphrases, which are (mostly) grammatically correct, but nonsensical. These are easy to remember (for humans), but difficult to guess (for humans and computers).

title: Würfelware
description: Generates passphrases within KeePass.

title: KeePassDiceware
description: A plugin that provides a custom, configurable password generator implementation that generates diceware-style passwords.

title: KeePassDPG
description: A plugin that allows creating easy to remember passwords based on a word dictionary (with support for custom character substitutions, specific letter capitalization, ...).

title: PasswordChangeReminder
shortdesc: Reminds you to change entry passwords.
description: This plugin periodically reminds you to change the password of certain entries after specific time spans.

title: PatternPass
shortdesc: Allows to store and view pattern-based passwords.
description: This plugin allows to store and view pattern-based passwords (like the Android lock-screen).

title: PEDCalc
shortdesc: Allows to define a default lifetime for passwords.
description: This plugin allows to define a default lifetime for passwords, which will be used to calculate the next expiry date of an entry everytime you change its password. The default lifetime can be defined on both group level and entry level.

title: PickCharsDeferred
description: This plugin changes the behavior of the {PICKCHARS} placeholder. Instead of asking for characters at the very beginning of auto-type, it will postpone it to the place where it occurs in the auto-type sequence. This is useful when a login screen consists of two parts and it is not known in advance what characters will be needed.

title: Pronounceable Password Generator
description: This plugin adds a custom password generation algorithm, which generates pronounceable passwords.

title: AdvancedConnect
shortdesc: Allows to specify applications for direct connections.
description: AdvancedConnect allows to specify different applications for direct connections.

title: QuickConnectPlugin
description: QuickConnectPlugin allows you to connect to Windows/Linux/ESXi hosts (via Remote Desktop, vSphere Client, PuTTY, ...).

title: QuickSearch
description:
QuickSearch is a plugin providing enhanced search capabilities. It can be used as a replacement for the built-in QuickFind toolbar control. Features include:
Search as you type aka instant search or incremental search. Match anywhere. Quick access to search settings.

title: QualityColumn
description: Adds support for a 'Password Quality' column in the main entry list.
note:
KeePass 2.x has a built-in command 'Password Quality' (in the main menu 'Find')
for showing a password quality report.

title: QualityHighlighter
shortdesc: Highlights entries based on the password quality.
description: This plugin highlights entries based on the password quality. Highlighting can be turned on/off using a toolbar button.
note:
KeePass 2.x has a built-in command 'Password Quality' (in the main menu 'Find')
for showing a password quality report.

title: RuleBuilder
shortdesc: Simplifies password changes with entry-specific generator rules.
description: This plugin makes it easy to tell KeePass how to generate a password for each entry and streamlines the process of changing passwords.

title: StrengthReport
description: Create detailed password strength reports (multiple formats like PDF, CSV, ...) for all entries in a KeePass database. Various strength measuring methods are supported (including dictionary-based tests). Reports can be customized (layout, font, size, colors, etc.).
note:
KeePass 2.x has a built-in command 'Password Quality' (in the main menu 'Find')
for showing a password quality report.

title: TAN Placeholder
shortdesc: Adds support for a placeholder that retrieves a TAN.
description: This plugin adds support for a placeholder that retrieves a TAN.

title: TeamViewerAndAmmyy
shortdesc: Conveniently run TeamViewer or Ammyy Admin.
description: This plugin allows you to directly run TeamViewer or Ammyy Admin with credentials stored in the KeePass database.

title: Title Display
description: This is a plugin for KeePass that allows the management of the main window title display.

title: TrayRecentFiles
shortdesc: Lists recent files in the system tray icon menu.
description: This plugin lists your recent files directly in the system tray icon menu.

title: TrueCrypt/VeraCrypt Mount
description: Plugins to mount TrueCrypt/VeraCrypt volumes conveniently.

title: TrueCrypt/VeraCrypt AutoDismount
description: Plugins to automatically dismount selected or all TrueCrypt/VeraCrypt mounted volumes when all KeePass databases are locked/closed or when KeePass is exited. The plugins dismount TrueCrypt/VeraCrypt volumes after a file is locked/closed but make sure it's the last file that was unlocked/opened.

title: CertKeyProvider
description:
Allows KeePass to use certificates from the Windows certificate store as master key source.
This advanced plugin creates a random key, which is used to encrypt the KeePass database. This random key is encrypted using one or more certificates and stored in a key file.

title: Multi Cert Key Provider
description: This plugin allows KeePass to use a random key, which is encrypted with the RSA certificate of one or more users and is stored in a *.kmx file, as a master key source.

title: RSA Cert Key Provider
description:
Allows KeePass to use RSA certificates from the Windows certificate store as master key source.
From a selected RSA certificate, this simple plugin passes a part from the private key (for cryptographers: the d value) to KeePass as key. The private key must have been marked as 'Exportable' during the import into the certificate store.

title: KeyManager
description: Based on X.509 certificates, this key provider plugin allows a database to be encrypted for multiple users. It has a graphical user interface for managing certificates and keys.

title: Smart Certificate Key Provider
shortdesc: Certificate-based key provider with smart card support.
description: Encrypt and decrypt your database using an X.509 certificate stored on a smart card or in the Windows Certificate Store.

title: OtpKeyProv
shortdesc: Key provider based on one-time passwords.
description:
OtpKeyProv is a key provider based on one-time passwords. After protecting your database using this plugin, you need to generate and enter one-time passwords in order to open your database.
All generator tokens that follow the OATH HOTP standard (RFC 4226) are supported.
note:
If you instead want KeePass to generate one-time passwords, see the built-in
one-time password placeholders
and the KeePassOTP, KeeOtp2,
KeeTrayTOTP
and TwoFactorQRCodeReader plugins.

title: KeeChallenge
description: Allows to protect KeePass databases using YubiKey challenge-response authentication.

title: KeePassOTP
description:
This plugin adds advanced support for generating one-time passwords (TOTP and HOTP).
Features: auto-type placeholder {KPOTP}, column in the main entry list for displaying and using OTPs, multiple storage approaches for OTP secrets/states (as part of an entry or in a separate database), and more. It is compatible with various apps (Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, andOTP, etc.).
note:
KeePass has built-in menu commands and placeholders for generating HOTPs and TOTPs:
{HMACOTP} and
{TIMEOTP}. The plugin adds advanced functionality.

If you instead want to protect your KeePass database using one-time passwords
(i.e. one-time passwords need to be generated and entered in order to open
your database), see the OtpKeyProv plugin.

title: KeeOtp2
description: KeeOtp2 provides a form to display one-time passwords. The TOTP secret keys are stored in a normalized format, so this plugin is fully compatible with the built-in OTP function (see the note below). It also can be used as a GUI for the built-in OTP function.
note:
KeePass has built-in menu commands and placeholders for generating HOTPs and TOTPs:
{HMACOTP} and
{TIMEOTP}. The plugin adds advanced functionality.

If you instead want to protect your KeePass database using one-time passwords
(i.e. one-time passwords need to be generated and entered in order to open
your database), see the OtpKeyProv plugin.

title: KeeTrayTOTP
description: This plugin adds advanced support for generating Time-based One-Time Passwords (TOTPs) from the KeePass tray icon. It also provides a column in the main entry list to display and/or use TOTPs. TOTPs can also be sent by auto-type. The plugin is compatible with Google, Dropbox, Steam, and many more services.
note:
KeePass has built-in menu commands and placeholders for generating HOTPs and TOTPs:
{HMACOTP} and
{TIMEOTP}. The plugin adds advanced functionality.

If you instead want to protect your KeePass database using one-time passwords
(i.e. one-time passwords need to be generated and entered in order to open
your database), see the OtpKeyProv plugin.

title: TwoFactorQRCodeReader
shortdesc: Creates 2FA placeholder parameters from QR codes or OTP URLs.
description: This plugin creates two-factor authentication parameters used by the placeholders {HMACOTP} and {TIMEOTP} from a QR code (displayed on the screen or in the clipboard) or from an OTP URL.

title: Key Xchanger
description: A bluetooth key provider plugin that allows you to save keys on your phone and then send them via bluetooth to unlock your KeePass database.

title: KeePassRFID
shortdesc: Key provider using RFID/NFC smart cards.
description: Encrypt and decrypt your database using an RFID/NFC smart card.

title: KeePerso
description: Encrypt and decrypt your database using Personalausweis eID (via AusweisApp2).

title: KeePass2Trezor
description: Encrypt and decrypt your database using a Trezor device.

title: LoginCard Key Provider
shortdesc: Key provider using RFID LoginCard (OWOK light).
description: Encrypt and decrypt your database using an RFID LoginCard (OWOK light).

title: Token Engine Key Provider
description:
This plugin provides two-factor authentication to a KeePass database with a token (possession) and the token PIN (knowledge).
The token is accessed using the digitronic Token Engine. It is possible to bind additional tokens to a database in order to allow multiple users to access the data.

title: KeePassKeyServer
shortdesc: Key provider that retrieves a key from a key server.
description: This plugin is a key provider that retrieves a key (as part of the database master key) from a key server. The key server supplies the key only if certain conditions are met (computer hardware ID, user name, IP address, etc.).

title: Twofish Cipher
description: Enables KeePass to encrypt databases using the Twofish algorithm.

title: Serpent Cipher
description: Enables KeePass to encrypt databases using the Serpent algorithm.

title: Salsa Cipher
description: Enables KeePass to encrypt databases using the Salsa20 algorithm.

title: GostPlugin
shortdesc: Adds the GOST R 34.12-2015 encryption algorithm.
description: Enables KeePass 2.x to encrypt databases using the GOST R 34.12-2015 algorithm.

title: MultiCipher
description: This plugin allows to use two ciphers for encrypting a database file. Supported ciphers are AES-256, 3DES-192, ChaCha20 and Salsa20. Furthermore, YubiKey challenge-response authentication is supported.
note:
KeePass has built-in support for AES-256 and ChaCha20 as single algorithms.
Support for YubiKey challenge-response authentication is alternatively
provided by the KeeChallenge plugin.

title: KeePassQuickUnlock
description: KeePassQuickUnlock is a plugin which lets you re-open your database without your full password. If you want to re-open your database, you can type just a few characters (by default, the first 3 characters of your password) to unlock quickly and easily. If the wrong QuickUnlock key is entered, the database keeps locked and the full password is required to re-open.

title: LockAssist
description: LockAssist extends KeePass' lock/unlock mechanism in multiple ways: quick unlock (using a short PIN, optional expiry time), soft lock, all locked databases can be unlocked at once, and more.

title: KeePassWinHello
shortdesc: Unlocks databases quickly using Windows Hello (fingerprint, face, ...).
description:
This plugin is intended for fast authorization to a database (after its first unlock) using Windows Hello.
Windows Hello supports fingerprint recognition, facial recognition and more.

title: WinHelloUnlock
shortdesc: Manages database access credentials using Windows Hello (fingerprint, face, ...).
description:
This plugin allows you to unlock your database conveniently using biometrics via Windows Hello.
Windows Hello supports fingerprint recognition, facial recognition and more.

title: KeePassProtectedKeyStore
shortdesc: Creates and uses protected key stores.
description:
This plugin creates and uses protected key stores (using Windows Hello or the Windows Data Protection API (DPAPI)). Features:
Create a random protected key store or convert one or more existing master key components (master password, key file, key provided by another key provider plugin, Windows user account) to a protected key store. Create/import an emergency key recovery file. Automatically open a database where a protected key store is the only master key component.

title: WinKee
description:
WinKee helps to securely automate KeePass startup. WinKee separately encrypts, stores and retrieves KeePass database access credentials in the KeePass configuration file (KeePass.config.xml).
Password and key file path will be encrypted based on Windows account credentials (using the Windows Data Protection API (DPAPI)) - so anybody having access to the specific user account and the WinKee database keyfile will be granted KeePass database access. KeePass and WinKee can be configured to automatically open a specified database via command line argument options -keyfile: during a user's Windows session logon or at any time by e.g. using a batch file.

title: KeePassAutoUnlock
shortdesc: Opens a database when starting KeePass.
description: When starting KeePass, this plugin automatically opens a specific database. The master key for the database is stored in the KeePass configuration file, encrypted based on the Windows user account credentials (using the Windows Data Protection API (DPAPI)).

title: KeePassCPEO
description: This plugin allows adding custom commands in the expiry drop-down menu of the entry dialog.

title: KeeModifiedBy
shortdesc: Remembers who has modified an entry.
description: This plugin remembers who has modified an entry (operating system user name and machine name).

title: KeePassOpenId
description: This plugin allows you to save an OpenID provider used to register/login to websites instead of a user name and password. You can link the OpenID provider (e.g. Facebook) with an existing KeePass entry to create a reference to the provider user name/password.

title: KeePassRDP
shortdesc: Connects to a server via RDP.
description: This plugin allows to conveniently connect to a server via RDP.

title: EditEntryGroup
shortdesc: Allows changing the group of an entry in the entry dialog.
description: This plugin allows changing the group that an entry belongs to by using a drop-down selector within the entry editing dialog.

title: ExtendSelection
description: When double-clicking in the details view of the main window, this plugin extends the selection to the left and to the right until reaching white-space characters.

title: GlobalSearch
shortdesc: Allows searching in all open databases at once.
description: This plugin allows you to use KeePass' built-in search functions ('Find', 'Last Modified Entries', 'Large Entries', 'Password Quality', etc.) for searching in all open databases at once.

title: GroupColumn
shortdesc: Provides a column showing the group of an entry.
description: This plugin provides a column in the main entry list that shows the group an entry is in (and the number of entries in that group).

title: iTanMaster
description:
iTans or 'indexed security tokens' are becoming standard to improve access security in online banking and similar applications.
iTanMaster provides easy and fast access to the encrypted storage of such indexed security tokens.
iTanMaster supports single, dual (e.g. Interactive Brokers) and triple token systems (e.g. Flatex AG) where the final access TAN is constructed from multiple separately indexed and then concatenated token parts.

title: RDCAutoTypeAndTCATO
shortdesc: RDC auto-type support and improved TCATO selection.
description: This plugin adds support for auto-typing into Remote Desktop Connection (RDC) windows. Additionally, it allows enabling Two-Channel Auto-Type Obfuscation (TCATO) for entries based on target applications (for example always enabling TCATO for browser windows).
note:
KeePass 2.25 and higher can auto-type into RDC windows without any plugin,
i.e. the RDCAutoTypeAndTCATO plugin is not required for this anymore,
but still for enabling TCATO based on target applications.

title: RDPPlugin
shortdesc: Connects to a server via RDP.
description: This plugin allows to conveniently connect to a server via RDP.

title: ReferenceCheck
shortdesc: Shows usage of field references and prevents accidental deletion.
description: This plugin shows usage of field references (in the entry dialog, in an entry list column, in an overview dialog, etc.) and prevents accidental deletion of referenced entries which would break them otherwise.

title: TCATO Placeholder
shortdesc: Allows to enable/disable TCATO per auto-type sequence.
description: This plugin adds support for a placeholder that allows to enable/disable TCATO, i.e. TCATO can be enabled/disabled per auto-type sequence.

title: AdvancedAutoType
description: This plugin provides various enhancements for the auto-type feature of KeePass, e.g. support for additional global hot keys to auto-type alternative sequences, additional features for the auto-type entry selection dialog (entry filtering, sortable columns, database name, auto-type certain fields only, ...), and more.

title: AutoTypeCustomFieldPicker
shortdesc: Allows to pick a custom field during auto-type.
description: This plugin provides support for a placeholder {PICKCUSTOMFIELD}. When auto-typing a sequence containing this placeholder, a window is displayed that allows to pick a custom string field (whose value is then inserted at the placeholder's position).

title: AutoTypeExclude
shortdesc: Provides a placeholder for excluding an entry from auto-type.
description: This plugin provides support for a placeholder to exclude an entry from auto-type based on the target window.

title: AutoTypeSearch
shortdesc: Provides quick searching as enhancement to global auto-type.
description: This plugin provides a quick searching capability as an enhancement to the global auto-type system. If a global auto-type is requested, but no matching entry for the active window is found, this plugin will show a quick as-you-type search window which lets you easily pick the entry to auto-type.

title: AutoTypeShow
description:
This plugin provides a {SHOWENTRY} auto-type placeholder. If you include this placeholder in your auto-type sequence for an entry, then after the auto-typing is done, the KeePass window will be shown with the entry selected.
Furthermore, the plugin has an option to set up a global hot-key to trigger a show-only auto-type (where it will act just like an ordinary auto-type, except it won't actually type anything).

title: AutoTypeSplitter
description: This plugin splits auto-typing into distinct parts. It is useful when a login screen consists of multiple parts and it is not known in advance when or what characters will be needed. Also, the plugin can be used as a delay method until the next page of a multi-page login loads and when a particular entry is to be entered in multiple places with varying arrangements/designs of input fields.

title: HaveIBeenPwned
description: This plugin checks entries against breach lists.

title: HIBPOfflineCheck
description: This plugin performs offline checks against the 'Have I Been Pwned' passwords file.

title: KeePassHIBP
description:
KeePassHIBP tests your passwords against the 'Have I Been Pwned' database.
The plugin hooks into two windows in KeePass (the 'Create Master Key' form and the 'Edit Entry' form). When you type into the password field, your input gets checked whether it has previously appeared in a data breach.

title: HaveIBeenPwnedKeePassPlugin
description: This plugin integrates the k-anonymity pwned password search from 'Have I Been Pwned'.

title: CheckPasswordBox
shortdesc: Prevents auto-typing passwords into wrong places.
description: This plugin adds a protection against accidentally auto-typing into the wrong place. It allows a check to be performed that the box that is about to be auto-typed into is a password box and not, for example, a user name box, search box, IM chat window, or similar.

title: Cycle Input Focus Plus
shortdesc: Browser extension to automate navigation during auto-type.
description: Cycle Input Focus Plus is a browser extension that provides customizable keyboard shortcuts for navigating to user name and password fields on login pages. It was developed to improve auto-type comfort with KeePass, freeing the user of the task of manually selecting the login field before performing auto-type, and also makes the auto-type procedure more robust against changes in the login page structure and layout.

title: Disambiguator
shortdesc: Allows matching by application name and control properties.
description: For each auto-type association, this plugin allows to specify the target application (executable file name/path) and control properties (name, class, automation ID, ...) that are required for a match.

title: ColoredPassword
shortdesc: Allows to use different colors for password characters.
description: This plugin allows to define different text and background colors for digits and special characters in passwords.

title: HotKeyEnabler
shortdesc: Allows to add entry-specific system-wide auto-type hot keys.
description: For each entry, this plugin allows to define a system-wide hot key that auto-types a specific sequence.

title: Character Copy
shortdesc: Allows copying individual characters from entry strings.
description: Character Copy is a lightweight KeePass plugin that integrates into KeePass' entry menu and allows users to securely copy individual characters from an entry's protected string fields, such as the password field.
note:
In conjunction with auto-type, the built-in
{PICKCHARS}
placeholder is more powerful and convenient.
The Character Copy plugin is useful for users who are not using auto-type
or do not want to customize the auto-type sequence.

title: Password Change Assistant
description: This plugin helps you with changing your passwords stored in KeePass. It integrates itself into the existing form for editing entries and provides a standalone form that can be accessed by the entry's context menu in addition. It does not automatically fill in and submit all the various forms for changing a password.

title: KeePassHttp
shortdesc: Allows KeePass to supply credentials via HTTP.
description:
KeePassHttp provides a secure means of exposing KeePass entries via HTTP for clients to consume.
For example, ChromeIPass, KeePassHelper,
Dash and NotesIPass are using KeePassHttp.

title: KeePassRest
shortdesc: Allows KeePass to supply credentials via REST.
description: This plugin for KeePass provides a secure HTTPS RESTful interface for clients to manage entries in KeePass. For example, SmartFTP can then use KeePass as a credentials store.

title: KeePassRPC
shortdesc: Allows KeePass to supply credentials via RPC.
description:
KeePassRPC enables secure, encrypted and bi-directional communication between KeePass and other applications via RPC.
Kee requires KeePassRPC.

title: KeePassCommander
shortdesc: Allows KeePass to supply credentials via named pipes.
description: The KeePassCommander plugin provides a communication channel between KeePass and other applications via named pipes. There exists a command line tool that uses this for querying data from KeePass.

title: KeePassNatMsg
shortdesc: Allows KeePass to supply credentials via Native Messaging.
description: The KeePassNatMsg plugin provides a communication channel between KeePass and other applications via Native Messaging.

title: Remote Desktop Manager Plugin
shortdesc: Allows KeePass to supply credentials to Remote Desktop Manager.
description: This plugin allows KeePass being used as credential repository for Remote Desktop Manager.

title: KeeSAPLogon
description: This plugin allows to conveniently logon to SAP systems.
note:
A less convenient solution without a plugin can be found here:



Using KeePass Instead of SAP Logon.

title: KPSAPLaunch
shortdesc: Integration with SAP GUI and NWBC.
description: This plugin provides an integration with SAP GUI and NetWeaver Business Client (NWBC).

title: SalesforcePlugin
description: Login to your Salesforce environments using this KeePass plugin. Instead of auto-type, your credentials will be passed through in a link.

title: Keebuntu
shortdesc: Plugins to better integrate KeePass with Linux systems.
description: Various plugins to better integrate KeePass 2.x with Linux systems (tray icon, launcher, ...).

title: Custom Icon Dashboarder
shortdesc: Statistics and management features for custom icons.
description: This plugin provides statistics (e.g. numbers and lists of entries and groups that use a specific custom icon) and advanced management features (e.g. download favicon for a URL) for custom icons.

title: Favicon Downloader
description: This plugin downloads and stores favicons. A favicon is the little icon/logo used to identify many websites, typically displayed in the browser's address bar, bookmark list and on tabs.

title: Yet Another Favicon Downloader
description: Yet Another Favicon Downloader (YAFD for short) is a plugin for KeePass 2.x that allows you to quickly download favicons for your password entries.

title: ExeIconPicker
description: ExeIconPicker lets you grab an icon from a Windows executable file (.exe), a library (.dll) or an icon file (.ico) and use it as an entry or group icon.

title: KeeOldFormatExport
shortdesc: Export to old KeePass file formats.
description: This plugin adds support for exporting data to old KeePass file formats. Supported formats are KeePass KDB (1.23) and KeePass KDBX (2.19).
note:
For opening/importing old files, no plugin is required.
KeePass is fully backward compatible.

title: KdbxLite
description: This plugin creates lite database files. Every time you save a '*.kdbx' file, the plugin creates a '*.lite.kdbx' file (in the same directory) that contains everything except entry attachments.

title: SecExchange
description: This plugin allows to conveniently send KeePass entries via Secure Exchanges.

title: Seclave Plugin
shortdesc: Export to Seclave password manager device.
description:
This plugin adds functionality for exporting KeePass entries to a Seclave Password Manager. It supports both export of all entries or a selected group of entries.
Seclave Password Manager is a key ring size device for secure and convenient storing of passwords and crypto keys.

title: SimpleSelectionExport
description: This plugin allows you to export basic entry information to flat text files (for instance TXT and CSV). It is useful when you want to send a quick overview of an arbitrary set of entries to parties who are not using KeePass.
note:
KeePass has a built-in command for exporting selected entries to
certain formats (e.g. CSV): after selecting the entries, click on
the menu item 'Entry' → 'Data Exchange' → 'Export Entry'.
The plugin provides support for additional formats.

title: TheVaultExport
shortdesc: Export to The Vault CSV files.
description: This plugin adds support for exporting KeePass entries to a CSV file readable by The Vault.

title: MSWifiPlugin
description: This plugin allows to import wireless connection information saved in Windows into KeePass and afterwards to export this information back to Windows. This can be used to back up existing wireless connections or to transfer them from one system to another.

title: KeeAutoExec
description: This plugin allows to automatically open additional databases when opening a database.

title: KeeLocker
description: This plugin opens BitLocker volumes.

title: KeePassTimestampChanger
description: This plugin provides a dialog that allows to change the timestamps of an entry.
note:
Warning:
KeePass' synchronization depends on correct timestamps.
When changing timestamps using the plugin, synchronization may not work
as expected anymore (e.g. entries may be overwritten by older copies).

title: IOProtocolExt
shortdesc: Adds support for SCP, SFTP and FTPS.
description:
This plugin adds support for loading/saving files from/to servers via SCP, SFTP and FTPS.
KeePass can handle FTP by default (using classes of the .NET framework). However, this plugin replaces the FTP handler to use WinSCP instead. So, if you have problems with the .NET FTP classes, installing IOProtocolExt might solve them.
Due to its usage of WinSCP, the IOProtocolExt plugin only works on Windows. If you are using Linux, consider other plugins (like SftpSync) instead.

title: SftpSync
shortdesc: Adds support for SFTP and SCP.
description: This plugin adds support for loading/saving files from/to servers via SFTP and SCP.
note:
The IOProtocolExt plugin also adds
support for SFTP/SCP and additionally supports FTPS, but it only works
on Windows (in contrast to the SftpSync plugin).

title: SftpSync (fork)
description:
This plugin adds support for loading/saving files from/to servers via SFTP and SCP.
with updated SSH.NET library, configurable
connection timeout, etc.
note:
The IOProtocolExt plugin also adds
support for SFTP/SCP and additionally supports FTPS, but it only works
on Windows (in contrast to the SftpSync plugin).

title: KP2faChecker
description: This plugin provides a column in the main entry list and a form that display whether a website supports two-factor authentication (2FA).

title: KPEntryTemplates
shortdesc: Allows to design new entry types based on templates.
description:
KPEntryTemplates is a plugin that is supposed to make it easier for KeePass to be used for storing additional things than web logins and extend the templating system.
The primary interface for the plugin is an extra tab that shows up in the 'Add Entry' form. By default going to the tab on a new entry will present you with one of two buttons, 'Init As Template' or 'Set Template Parent'. 'Init As Template' marks the entry as a template, and shows the GUI builder interface on the tab. Once you have a template set up, you can create entries based on it.

title: KPEnhancedListView
description: KPEnhancedListView extends the entry list in the KeePass main window. It adds inline editing and the ability to double-click the empty list view area to add a new entry.

title: KPEnhancedEntryView
description: KPEnhancedEntryView extends the details view in the KeePass main window. All fields (standard and custom strings) are shown in a grid view, field values (and names for custom strings) are in-place editable, attachments can be dragged and dropped to and from files in Windows File Explorer, metadata properties are shown on a separate tab, and the original textual details view is still available on another tab.

title: KPFieldsAdminConsole
shortdesc: Get statistics and perform bulk operations on fields.
description: KPFieldsAdminConsole is a KeePass plugin to get some statistics and perform bulk operations on fields.

title: KPLauncher
shortdesc: Runs KeePass for a specific architecture.
description:
By default, KeePass runs natively on most operating systems (i.e. without compatibility layer and without emulation). However, there are special situations where it may be necessary to run KeePass for a different architecture (with compatibility layer or with emulation). For example, if you have an ARM64 operating system and want to use an old plugin that is available only for x64, you need to run KeePass as x64 process (with emulation). KPLauncher allows this.
KPLauncher can run KeePass as x86 (x86-32), x64 (x86-64) or ARM64 (AArch64) process, provided that the operating system supports it.

title: MinLock
description:
MinLock keeps a minimized KeePass locked (re-locks almost immediately after it becomes unlocked, as long as it is still minimized).
This happens to be the case when KeePass is locked and minimized and then its global auto-type feature is used, which can unlock KeePass and leave it unlocked.

title: NotesFontSelector
shortdesc: Allows to change the notes font.
description: This plugin allows you to select the font that is used for an entry's notes.
note:
Without this plugin, KeePass uses the default graphical user interface (GUI) font
for the notes (which is also used by most other controls).
This font can be changed in the operating system settings.
For details, see the FAQ item
'How to change the GUI font (size)?'.

title: NotesSearch
shortdesc: Allows to search in the current entry notes.
description: This plugin allows to search in the notes of the currently selected entry.

title: QrCodeGenerator
description: This plugin can display passwords as QR codes.

title: KeePassQRCodeView
shortdesc: Displays entry fields as QR codes.
description: KeePassQRCodeView is a plugin for KeePass 2.x which shows QR codes for entry fields. These codes can be scanned to copy the encoded data to the scanner (smartphone, ...).

title: KeePassPinEntry
description: This plugin allows KeePass to respond to GPG PinEntry requests for you.

title: KeeAgent
shortdesc: Adds SSH agent support to KeePass.
description: The KeeAgent plugin adds SSH agent support to KeePass. It emulates Pageant.
